Container.Name: teamarr
Container.Overview: Generates sports EPG data and manages channels for Dispatcharr. Created by Pharaoh Labs; this template is community-maintained.
Container.Description:
Teamarr builds sports guide (XMLTV) data and works with Dispatcharr to create and manage channels.
**Setup:** open the WebUI, follow the Getting Started guide on the dashboard to connect Dispatcharr, create templates, and add teams or event groups.
Point Dispatcharr's EPG source at: http://[your-unraid-ip]:9195/api/v1/epg/xmltv
**Important:** the Data path holds teamarr.db, which contains all your configuration. Do not delete it.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface and EPG endpoint port

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, settings and logs. Never delete teamarr.db.
